title: Folhas de Operação — Valores
prompt:
Create a high-fidelity 1600x1000 landscape desktop screenshot for GO Itaim Dashboard Geral, route "Valores". Follow the chosen "Folhas de Operação" design system from the approved overview: light warm ivory paper, graphite text, cobalt navigation and controls, subtle yellow divider tabs, fine table rules, small acetate-like surfaces and disciplined spacing. No browser chrome or device frame. Use the supplied official GO Itaim logo reference and preserve all product terms.

Show the left app navigation exactly: Principal (Visão Geral, Análise, UTR, Comparação), Operacional (Entregadores, Valores selected, Prioridade | Promo, Evolução, Dedicado), Marketing (Operacional Marketing, Marketing). Header breadcrumb "Operacional › Valores". In the header center show green refresh icon and "Sincronizado", followed by clipped horizontally scrolling city/date items "Guarulhos 29/09 · Manaus 28/09 · São Paulo 2.0 27/09 · Sorocaba 26/09", subtle edge fading; theme/profile at right. These dates are demonstrative placeholders only.

Immediately below, show the full two-row filter used by the dashboard: "Período" with "Ano/Semana" selected / "Intervalo", "Ano 2026", multi-select "Semana 05, 06, 07"; second row individual dropdowns "Praça Todas", "Sub praça Todas", "Origem Todas", "Turno Todos", and button "Limpar". Keep the ticker in its own header strip and every filter visible.

Page header title exactly "Valores por entregador", subtitle "Acompanhe o repasse de cada entregador", button "Exportar Excel". Four metric tiles with current labels: "Total geral", "Entregadores", "Total de corridas", "Taxa média". Search input placeholder exactly "Pesquisar entregador por nome ou ID...". Below, a readable, sortable table with columns "Entregador", "Total", "Corridas", "Média"; three clearly synthetic rows such as Entregador 001, Entregador 002, Entregador 003 with plausible Brazilian currency formatted as R$ and localized counts. Use warm yellow for rank/folio indexing and cobalt for values and selected state. Do not add filters or actions not present in this view. All sample values are illustrative, not live data.
demoData: Totais e linhas sintéticos; não usar como dados do Supabase.
